friction: validate_plan first failed: metadata.version is required but omd://reference does not say so; the full schema is only in the separate omd://plan-schema resource

validate_plan does not list the allowed DV/constraint/objective names for unknown names (just 'Unknown variable'); the builder tool plan_add_dv accepted a bogus name without checking it, despite its description; I used OpenConcept HybridTwin variable paths from memory
operating_points with ac|... keys (structural_fudge, propeller diameter, engine rating) passed validation but were silently ignored in the run (engine stayed at 750 hp, prop at 2.28 m)
config.aircraft_data given alongside aircraft_template was silently ignored (results identical to the template)

Workaround: the plan-level initial_values list (documented only in plan-schema) applied the airframe overrides; structural_fudge could not be read back through get_results, and it was only inferred to apply from the OEW change
run_plan overrides with a partial components list replaced the list instead of merging, failing with 'type is a required property'

The reference does not document that include_cost_model uses the paper's cost coefficients (fuel $2.50/gal, $36/MWh, etc.) or lets you set them; I assumed the built-in doc_per_nmi matches the paper's model
With recording_level=minimal the validator warns 'Optimizer recorded 1 driver iterations' even when the optimizer ran many iterations (false positive)
Unscaled SLSQP stopped early at non-optimal points (e.g. DOC 0.5754 with 174 kg of MTOW margin unused); adding DV ref and constraint scalers was needed to reach 0.5420
Final constraint residuals are tiny violations: MTOW_margin -4.1e-7 kg and SOC_final -6.0e-8
